reason: Independent pre-execution review found Critical execution integrity defects after R2 freeze: actual consumed pilot/regression manifests are not directly frozen R2 artifacts, and stage locks do not bind output/ledger/raw/completed evidence used by aggregation.

critical_findings.title: Real executor consumes unpinned V20 pilot/regression manifests
facts: tools/engine.py load_manifest maps pilot and regression to ../20_person_fallen_v6_target_support_config/manifests/pilot156.json and regression1.json.
The verified R2 freeze binds the local 22/.../manifests/pilot156.json and regression1.json, but does not bind the two V20 manifest paths consumed by load_manifest.
critical_findings.reasoning: A manifest edit at the live V20 paths after freeze verification changes the actual real-run input without changing the verified R2 freeze hash or its bindings. The local copied manifests therefore do not protect the real execution path.
critical_findings.risk: This can alter request identity, budget composition, reuse membership, and source split. It also makes the claimed VAL/Holdout exclusion unenforceable end-to-end for pilot/regression.
affected_confirmations: Pilot reuse does not resend during full_remaining

critical_findings.title: Completion locks do not bind stage output or request evidence consumed by aggregation
facts: tools/engine.py lock_ok validates only COMPLETION_LOCK.json status, the hash of summary.json, and summary gate PASS.
aggregate_full reads output.jsonl from pilot and full_remaining after lock_ok succeeds.
claimed.json, response.raw, transport.json, completed.json, request_events.jsonl, and output.jsonl are not hashed into COMPLETION_LOCK.json.
critical_findings.reasoning: A changed output.jsonl can retain a valid summary.json and completion lock. aggregate_full will then consume the altered rows; it only checks row count, item uniqueness, and decision gates, not the raw/claimed/completed evidence chain.
critical_findings.risk: Stage locking is not an immutable execution-integrity barrier. Full-436 aggregation and gate results can be forged or accidentally drift after a stage appears complete.
affected_confirmations: stage lock cannot be bypassed by an executor override

high_findings.title: Budget truth is exact today but not unique in implementation
facts: tools/engine.py independently embeds 156, 1, 280, and 436 in stage, aggregate, and pending-count checks.
protocol/execution_plan.json independently repeats the budget object.
high_findings.reasoning: Changing the normative budget requires coordinated edits in multiple files. A partial update can leave freeze validation, stage gates, and aggregate behavior inconsistent.
high_findings.risk: Future recovery/rebudget work can silently create a false PASS or false FAIL even if EXPECTED_BUDGET itself is updated correctly.
